cmh16Observations: Legend distinguishes landing arrows, Marine positions night15Sep, Marine positions night16Sep, and BHL. These are different semantics.
Night15 positions appear as separate north RedBeach and south BlueBeach line segments; other small positions are isolated.
Night16 positions are split by regiments and other unit features, with visible gaps; the source supplies no complete all-owner partition.
BHL is separately labeled and extends beyond some actual position segments. The planned boundary is not a substitute for observed front.
Inchon and Ascom diagonal hatching is consistent with urban-area portrayal, not a territorial owner style in this legend. It must not be promoted to a control mask.
Unit-symbol ovals and squares are not control polygons. The coast is geographic context, not by itself proof that the gap between a frontage and coast is uniformly controlled.

confirmed: 15Sep: RedBeach force captured high ground behind the beach and then sent patrols to OA; city-wide complete ownership is not stated for the first landing frame.
16Sep: first Marines objectives on O-1 are reported occupied at0206, O-3 reached bynoon, and advance towardBHL began1600.
16Sep: fifth Marines advanced to capture the remainder ofInchon; KMC mopped up city snipers.
